design_note: Uses four strictly atomic reference facts (age 73, 2-day right knee aching, 2-day right knee swelling, and measured 103 F temperature tonight) with a 1-word span difference (15 vs 16 words), 10 shared trailing tokens, and zero diagnosis labels ('arthritis', 'gout', and 'sepsis' omitted from prompt texts).
